findings.title: Diff reverts the just-committed Jinja2Templates autoescape fix (commit e11187e)
findings.problem: This change replaces Jinja2Templates(env=jinja2.Environment(..., autoescape=True)) with Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True), the pattern HEAD commit e11187e deliberately replaced because Starlette deprecated passing **env_options through. Verified against pinned starlette 0.52.1: the kwarg still works today but raises a DeprecationWarning on every import, and fastapi/starlette carry no version pin in pyproject.toml.
findings.fix_hint: Restore the pre-diff code: build jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)), autoescape=True) and pass it via Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env), matching commit e11187e.
findings.why_it_matters: Templates render instance names, config values, and search/log history; if a future dependency bump drops the default autoescape, every templated page becomes an XSS vector with no code change needed.

members.title: Revert re-introduces fragile autoescape path, enabling future stored XSS
members.problem: The diff reverts commit e11187e, which replaced Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True) with an explicitly constructed jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) passed via env=. Confirmed against installed starlette 0.52.1 that **env_options is still passed through today but emits a DeprecationWarning marked for removal. fastapi/starlette are unpinned in pyproject.toml, so a future upgrade can pull a Starlette that drops the passthrough, at which point autoescape=True is ignored and Jinja2 reverts to its own default (autoescape off).

members.why_it_matters: settings.html renders user-supplied config values (inst_name, inst.url, inst.missing_tag, inst.cutoff_tag) relying entirely on autoescape. If autoescape silently stops being applied, stored fields containing script tags execute as stored XSS for every viewer.
members.fix_hint: restore the explicit jinja2.Environment(loader=..., autoescape=True) built and passed via Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env), as commit e11187e did

members.title: Unsupported autoescape argument prevents startup
members.problem: With installed Starlette 1.2.1, importing triggarr.web.routes raises TypeError: Jinja2Templates.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'autoescape'. triggarr/__main__.py imports this module, so the application cannot start. Although uv.lock lists an older version, Docker installs from pyproject.toml without the lock, and FastAPI is unconstrained.

members.title: XSS autoescape protection now goes through Starlette's deprecated env_options path, and the unpinned Docker build will fail to start once Starlette removes it
members.problem: This diff reverts commit e11187e. In the installed Starlette 0.52.1 the call goes through **env_options, which Starlette has deprecated. Verified: uv run pytest -W error::DeprecationWarning fails at collection of tests/test_web.py. The Dockerfile installs with pip install . which ignores uv.lock, and pyproject lists fastapi with no version pin. The first image built after Starlette drops **env_options will raise TypeError when routes.py is imported, and the whole web UI will fail to start.

members.why_it_matters: Autoescape currently holds only through a deprecated library path. When Starlette removes that path, every Docker user gets a container that cannot start.
members.fix_hint: Keep the preconfigured jinja2.Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(...), autoescape=True) passed via env= (do not revert e11187e); optionally add a filterwarnings=error::DeprecationWarning pytest setting so the regression is caught.

members.title: Reverts HEAD commit's move to the supported preconfigured-Environment API and goes back to deprecated Jinja2Templates **env_options
members.problem: The diff undoes HEAD commit e11187e word for word. The locked Starlette (0.52.1) still accepts autoescape=True but raises a DeprecationWarning. The Dockerfile runs pip install . and ignores uv.lock; pyproject.toml lists fastapi and jinja2 with no version bounds. So a release image can pull a newer Starlette. On a version without the passthrough, Jinja2Templates(...) fails when routes.py is imported, and the app never starts.

members.why_it_matters: Starlette is unpinned and the Docker build does not use the lock file, so a future image rebuild can crash at import time. That takes down the whole web UI, not one route.
members.fix_hint: Keep the HEAD version: build jinja2.Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(TEMPLATES_DIR), autoescape=True) and pass env=. If the goal is simplification, drop autoescape=True, because Starlette's _create_env already defaults autoescape to True.

members.title: Revert of fix e11187e: autoescape now goes through Starlette's deprecated **env_options, which can crash startup on an upgrade
members.problem: This diff undoes the last commit (e11187e, 'use preconfigured jinja2.Environment for autoescape'). That commit's message says Starlette removed the **env_options passthrough and that autoescape=True broke because of it. On the installed Starlette (0.52.1), Jinja2Templates.__init__ still accepts **env_options, but only with a DeprecationWarning. pyproject.toml lists fastapi with no version pin, so a future image build can pull a Starlette that has dropped **env_options; the autoescape=True keyword then raises TypeError when routes.py is imported, and the web UI cannot start. Any run with warnings promoted to errors also fails at import today.
